coder_notes: Registered phase is PHASE4 (excluded at S3 by script) but coded in full. The investigational intervention is the GammaTile Cs-131 brachytherapy device; bevacizumab or lomustine (physician choice) is adjuvant systemic therapy in both arms, coded soc_backbone; no pharmacological candidate. Neither drug is a registered intervention but the summary states every patient receives one of them. Steroids only permitted, not listed. MGMT: entry requires that methylation status be available (any status), coded eligibility though it does not select by status; adjudicator may prefer exploratory. IDH-wildtype is the diagnostic definition. EGFR amplification / chr7/10 / TERT appear only as alternative diagnostic features of molecular GBM and were not listed as biomarkers. Germline MMR/POLE exclusion not recorded (germline).
